text: Invoice #INV-4471 for Cardinal Supply bills the Team plan at 25 seats, but we only have 19 active users. The renewal charge posts on the 1st. I need the line item corrected before then or I'll be disputing a 6-seat overcharge. Who can adjust proration here?

Card on file was declined twice last week on the $2,340 renewal. My bank confirms both attempts cleared on their end, and a third went through, but your system still shows us past due and sent a dunning notice. Looks like a sync glitch rather than a real failed charge. Can you reconcile the payment status?

Two identical charges of $4,680 posted four minutes apart for the annual Enterprise renewal — $9,360 total, but only one year is valid. I need the duplicate refunded today. Card ends 8821. This is the second duplicate renewal to hit us; the last one took three weeks to unwind.

VAT-registered in the Netherlands, but every invoice since January shows US sales tax instead of a zero-rated reverse charge. I've entered our VAT ID (NL8-...) on the settings page and nothing changed. Finance needs corrected Q1 and Q2 invoices to file. Can you reissue with the proper tax treatment?
Where do I set the PO number that prints on each invoice PDF? Procurement wants it on everything going forward. Also, do archived invoices older than 12 months stay downloadable, or do they expire?

Postgres connector stopped syncing two of our tables yesterday, and nothing changed in the config. I suspect the workspace role for the connector's owner got downgraded when we reshuffled the team. Can you confirm that owner still has permission to run syncs?

On the Revenue Overview dashboard, the 'last 7 days' toggle resets to 'last 30 days' every time I switch tabs. Small thing, but it throws off our Monday standup. Chrome 126, and it happens on all three of my widgets.

The scheduled daily revenue report to our ops alias lands three hours late most mornings, and today it didn't arrive at all. Eleven recipients. We feed the 7am numbers into the warehouse standup. Slack alerts fire fine — only the email delivery lags.

BigQuery connector has failed on every sync since 06:00 with 'quota exceeded: tabledata.insertAll'. Ingestion volume hasn't changed in months. Our exec dashboards are frozen on yesterday's data and month-end close is tomorrow. Finance is blocked.

Since we rotated the SSO certificate this morning, every call from our nightly ETL returns 401 invalid_token. The service logins can't authenticate anymore. I think the SAML cert swap invalidated the API tokens your side issues. No jobs have run since, and it's cascading into the morning load. Need this working now.

How do I reset 2FA for a contractor whose phone got wiped? He's locked out of his own login and can't scan a new QR. I'm a workspace owner, so I should be able to trigger a reset, but I can't find the option. I don't want to just delete the user and lose his saved views.

I need to change the email on my login from f.lastname@cardinalsupply.com to a new alias. Every report notification and alert is tied to that address, so I want to be sure scheduled sends follow the change and nothing breaks. Is there a cooldown or re-verification step?

I'm getting login alerts from a foreign IP — three attempts in the past hour, two failed. I've already changed my password, but I don't see any active sessions to revoke. If someone's in with owner rights, they can export all our customer data. Please lock the profile and tell me how to force-logout every session.

We're at 19 of 20 seats on Team, and two new analysts start Monday. Before adding them, I want to know whether it's cheaper to bump to 25 seats mid-cycle or wait for renewal, and whether the extra seats keep our existing roles and SSO. What's the cleanest way to handle the two additions?

Our workspace owner, Marcus Webb, leaves the company Friday and his login will be disabled. Ownership has to move to me — I'm a current admin — before then, or the workspace goes ownerless and I'm told scheduled reports stop. He's handed everything over. What's the exact sequence so nothing lapses Friday?

Procurement needs a formal quote to move from Team to Enterprise for 60 seats by end of week to hit our Q3 budget cycle. I have the seat count. Send a PDF with volume pricing and the changes to limits and connectors, addressed to Cardinal Supply Co., so my controller can approve it.

Annual term renews in 9 days at a 22% higher rate, and the notice window on the portal is already shut. I want to lock current pricing on a new 12-month term before it auto-renews. Who can issue signature-ready paperwork today? I'm not approving a 22% jump without a real option in front of me.

Comparing Team vs Enterprise — does the higher tier change how roles and permissions work? We run 12 custom roles today and I want to know if they carry over before I ask for pricing. Mainly need to know if our current role structure survives an upgrade or gets rebuilt.

We're evaluating a switch from our current BI tool and want to migrate three workspaces of dashboards this week. My VP approved budget verbally and will kill the initiative if we slip past Friday. Can I get someone on a call today to scope a pilot and send terms?

Interested in the Shopify connector for a second storefront — eight more locations roll out in Q4. Can someone demo multi-store rollups and per-location dashboards for our ops lead before our platform review on the 20th? We're on Team today and want to see if this needs a tier bump.

Our annual vendor security review is due, and risk wants Lumen's latest SOC 2 Type II report, a pen-test summary, and the subprocessor list. Deadline is the 30th. Who sends these, and is there an NDA step first? This is for compliance sign-off, not a purchase.

General note: the new dashboard builder is a big step up, much faster. One snag — when I duplicate a saved view, the filters don't copy over, so I rebuild them every time. No rush, just flagging since it bites me weekly. Everything else works great, keep it up.

Saw a Solutions Engineer role on your careers page. I'm not applying — just curious if it's remote for EU-based candidates, since my brother-in-law is a strong fit and asked. No rush, whenever someone has a moment.

Retail Systems Weekly is running a piece on analytics tools for mid-size retailers and wants to cite us as a Lumen customer. They asked me to confirm high-level usage. I'd rather not field a reporter — who handles press, and can they respond by Thursday?

Feature request from our ops lead: scheduled reports need a 'send only if data changed' option. We push about 30 near-identical daily reports and half are no-ops, which trains people to ignore them. Is this on the roadmap? Knowing would help me plan our report cleanup this quarter.
